answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through attestations from peers who have already built costly, time-stamped transaction histories; each attestation locks the sponsor’s stake, which is slashed if the newcomer is later caught farming identities. A sybil operator must therefore fund many durable histories and persuade established agents to risk collateral, not merely mint wallets. Even names like quartz, juniper, and orchard gain no weight without that chain of accountable sponsorship.
